email_body:
Dear Nestlé Baby team,

I'm applying for the Brand Manager Internship in your Nutrition team in Brussels, starting end of January 2027 for six months.

Your brief looks close to the work I already do: creating digital assets and landing pages, keeping website and product content current, and then checking what the numbers say before sharing what I learned. At Episto I handle on-page content and CMS publishing for client sites, including a pharmacists' association where I keep a consistent layout across roughly 600 member profile pages. Freelance, I build and run websites in WordPress, write the content, and measure the results in GA4, Search Console and Semrush.

I live in Zwijndrecht, Belgium, I'm fluent in English, and my Dutch is improving. I'd like to bring that hands-on, detail-driven approach to a portfolio of products parents actually trust.

Baver Ok

cover_letter:
Dear Nestlé Baby team,

A portfolio that has to earn its place on a Belgian shelf, a campaign that has to work on social and in print, and artwork that has to be right before it reaches the factory — that mix of creative and operational is what draws me to this internship.

My work so far is digital marketing with a builder's habit. At Episto I handle on-page SEO and write content for client websites, publish and maintain pages and blog posts in WordPress, and report on results in Semrush, Ahrefs, Google Analytics and Search Console. For majistraleczacilari.org.tr I build and maintain a pharmacists' association site, keeping a consistent layout across roughly 600 member profile pages — repetitive, detail-heavy work that has to stay uniform. Freelance, I designed and run baverok.com and mirook.com end to end: structure, content, structured data and iterative audits. At KXP I supported the team on SharePoint-based digital workplace projects for ŞOK Market and Aras Kargo, so I know what it means to work inside a larger process with other teams and fixed deadlines.

My degree background is computer science, at Karel de Grote Hogeschool in Antwerp, rather than marketing. That was deliberate in how I work: I'm at home in the technical side of content, CMS and analytics, and I've built the marketing side through practice and certifications — Semrush SEO Fundamentals and SEO Toolkit, GA4, Google Ads Search and HubSpot Content Marketing.

I live in Zwijndrecht, Belgium, I'm fluent in English and currently B1 in written Dutch, and I'd be glad to discuss how I can support your campaigns, product launches and CRM communication from the end of January 2027.

Kind regards,
Baver Ok

cv_highlights:
- CMS content management: publishing and updating pages, blog posts and media for client websites in WordPress (Elementor, Astra, Rank Math), and keeping existing content current — the same rhythm the role needs for campaign assets and CRM updates
- Shopify stores (harwindtf.com, custompremiumshirt.com): store design, product catalogue creation and maintenance, and blog publishing — closest match to product updates and launch support
- Built and maintained majistraleczacilari.org.tr with a consistent layout across roughly 600 member profile pages: structured, detail-heavy work carried out to a fixed template
- Digital assets and landing pages: designed and hand-coded a landing page with structured data, accessible markup and an enquiry flow for baverok.com; built mirook.com with JSON-LD schema and iterative technical audits
- Analytics and reporting: Google Analytics, Search Console, Semrush, Ahrefs and Google Ads — comfortable picking up new data tools to evaluate campaigns and competition
